title: Card declaration
description: What a cortex card declares about the payload it draws. This is a DOCUMENT, not code: nothing in cortex-ui loads or enforces this file. It is written down from what cortex's code and tests already hold, as the input to the OpenDDIL ADR. The root is a card CONTRACT (an exported `*_CONTRACT` object). $defs/registrationRow is the same contract as cortex sends it on POST /register_frontend_capabilities. $defs/archetypePackage is the ADR-0055 package that a contract joins in `src/archetypes/` through `defineArchetype`. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (equality and subset across fields) are listed under `x-cortex-rules`, each with the test that enforces it, or marked `enforced: none` when only the census holds it.

x-cortex-provenance.census: 29 exported *_CONTRACT objects in 28 files (src/**/*.contract.ts, src/**/*.contracts.ts, src/archetypes/*/contract.ts), 115 fields; 49 registration rows from assembleDerivedCapabilities(), 26 distinct archetypes, 0 legacy; 10 archetype packages in ARCHETYPE_PACKAGES. Read off the live modules by a throwaway vitest probe, not by grepping source. Every member validates against this schema, and each negative control in x-cortex-controls is refused.
sources: src/registry/frontendCapabilities.ts (FrontendCapability, cortex's type for the row)

archetype.description: The archetype id. Structural, never domain vocabulary. Several rows may share one contract (six output types bind MarkdownRenderer's), but one archetype has one contract.

component.description: The React component that DRAWS the payload. 28 of 29 contracts.

consumer.description: A function that ACTS ON the payload instead of drawing it. 1 of 29 (CANVAS_SEED_CONTRACT: canvasSeedFromArtifact). The registration row then carries `component: ""`, which is a claim (nothing renders this), not a missing value.

layout.description: Where the card sits. Census: full-width 25, grid-col-1 2, none 1, rows 1. `none` goes with `consumer`.
layout.x-cortex-finding: `rows` (COMPETING_MEASURES_CONTRACT) is outside cortex's own FrontendCapability.layout type ("full-width" | "grid-col-1" | "none"); assembleDerivedCapabilities passes it through an `as` cast, so it reaches the wire. The producer declares layout as an untyped string, so nothing refuses it on either side.

recomputes.description: ADR-0042 Ruling 9's discriminant: whether re-evaluating the question would return a different answer as plan state moves. A contract field, never a refusal reason. Present on 20 of 29 (true 10, false 10). ABSENT on 9, and absent is not stated to mean false.

fields.description: The payload keys the card reads, each with its encoding. Registration publishes Object.keys(fields), in order, as expected_fields.

rowFields.description: Per-row keys of an array field, declared like `fields`. 1 of 29.

rowRequirements.description: Named structural facts about the rows (minRows, absentIsNotZero, shortfallIsUpstream, ...). Tests assert them by name. 20 of 29. Keys are per-archetype; values seen: number 20, boolean 33, array 2.

refusalReasons.description: The closed vocabulary of reasons this card may give for refusing a payload. Census: 20 non-empty, 6 empty, 3 absent. EMPTY is a statement: the card never refuses (KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT, the universal fallback, is asserted empty by test). ABSENT is not stated to mean empty: ILLUSTRATION, MODEL_EXPLANATION and WORKFLOW_CASE declare absences through their package instead.

propertyNames.description: snake_case payload keys. `__payload` is the one sentinel: the field IS the whole component payload (INSTANCES_BY_PROPERTY_CONTRACT, with isWholeComponentPayload: true).

field.description: One payload key. Two spellings exist side by side: the ENCODING form (how it travels; 47 fields) and the TYPE form (the scalar it is; 68 fields). Never both. The spelling is per-contract habit, not a semantic split.

required.description: Census: true 31, false 84. A required field the payload lacks is a refusal, never a default.

encoding.description: How the value travels. Census: array 25, object 10, string 8, number 1, boolean 1, json-string 1, enum 1. `json-string` is a JSON document carried in a string (CHART_WIDGET chart_data).

type.description: The scalar it is. Census: string 52, number 12, boolean 3, enum 1.

parsesTo.description: What the card parses the encoded value into. Census: array-of-objects 21, object 5, array-of-strings 1. NOT required for array/object: 11 array or object fields omit it.

values.description: The closed value set of an enum field.

requiredKeys.description: Keys an object field must carry.

elementRequiredKeys.description: Keys every element of an array field must carry.

isWholeComponentPayload.description: The field is the entire payload, not a key in it. Paired with the `__payload` name.

mapsToProp.description: The component prop this key is handed to when the names differ. 1 field (WARNING_CARD). The contracts' own comments call a prop that differs from its payload key "the seam itself"; this is the one recorded exception.

registrationRow.description: The contract as cortex sends it: one element of RegisterFrontendCapabilitiesRequest.capabilities on POST /register_frontend_capabilities, built by assembleDerivedCapabilities(). The mesh-vocabulary half (subject_uri, object_uri, persona_fit, domain_fit) is the registry's; the rest is projected from the contract and never restated.

subject_uri.description: The engine output type that routes here. The dedupe key: one row per subject_uri.

component.description: contract.component, or "" when the contract names a consumer.

consumer.x-cortex-finding: Cortex sends `consumer` on 1 of 49 rows, but the producer's FrontendCapability (at 10ac02fe) declares no `consumer` property and sets no additionalProperties, so the receiver does not keep it as a declared field. Its only declared trace on the wire is inside the open `contract` object.

domain_fit.description: May be empty, and empty is sourced (the engine declares itself agnostic), not defaulted.

archetypePackage.description: ADR-0055: an archetype is a package, and an absence is a declared fact. The JSON-able part of what defineArchetype() accepts; the React `Card` is omitted. 10 packages. 7 of the 10 are also registered (WORKFLOW_CASE, ILLUSTRATION and MODEL_EXPLANATION draw only through other paths).

row.description: Cortex's copy of the backend row declaration (row.ts in each package).

reads.description: The row fields the card reads.

absences.description: The data-* attributes the card renders to DECLARE an absence: either a bare attribute (data-reason-absent) or an attribute with a value (data-model-question="deferred"). Scoped to one card's subtree (readDeclaredAbsences).

noAbsence.description: An explicit, CHECKED claim that the card has no payload-flippable absence (its noAbsence.test renders the parity population and fails if any data-* flips). 2 of 10 (DELTA_SET, SHORTFALL_GRID).

items.description: The other keys (payload, rows, envelope, value_unit, ...) are per-archetype.

x-cortex-rules.rule: every absence a fixture declares is in the package's absences
x-cortex-rules.enforced: defineArchetype.test.ts: "refuses a fixture declaring an absence outside the package's absences"

x-cortex-rules.rule: every reads field is in row.passthrough
x-cortex-rules.enforced: defineArchetype.test.ts: "refuses a reads field that row.passthrough does not declare"
registry.test.ts: "a duplicate id throws, naming the colliding path"

x-cortex-rules.rule: row.payload_key is a key of contract.fields
x-cortex-rules.enforced: none; it holds on 10 of 10 in the census
by construction in assembleDerivedCapabilities; assembleCapabilities.test.ts: "no derived row advertises a component the interpreter does not dispatch"

x-cortex-rules.rule: consumer names a function that is really exported
x-cortex-rules.enforced: assembleCapabilities.test.ts: "every ACTED-ON row names a consumer that is really exported"
assembleCapabilities.test.ts: "every derived row's expected_fields is a projection of its own contract"

x-cortex-rules.rule: one archetype has one contract across rows

x-cortex-rules.enforced: assembleCapabilities.test.ts: "never emits two entries for one subject_uri"

x-cortex-controls: Each of these, applied to a real census member, is REFUSED by this schema (ajv 8.18, draft 2020-12): a contract with both component and consumer; one with neither; layout "grid"; an unknown contract key; a field with both encoding and type; a field with neither; an enum field with no values; values on a non-enum field; parsesTo on a type-form field; encoding "xml"; an empty fields map; a camelCase field name; a package with noAbsence AND absences; one with empty absences and no noAbsence; an absence not spelled data-*; a blank noAbsence.reason; a registration row with an unknown key; contract_source "hand".
